<span id="introduction" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>The Barrows Brothers </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="dharokhead">https://files.catbox.moe/to1cz2.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513222840162582541.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> were originally composed of six wights, two more members were added after completing the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ritual_of_the_Mahjarrat <nowiki>Ritual of the Mahjarrat</nowiki>]<nowiki> and </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Kindred_Spirits <nowiki>Kindred Spirits</nowiki>]<nowiki> quests.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ This guides aims to get you started on doing Barrows runs, and will focus on the original six brothers.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It will be assumed that you're using Magic </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and the entry-level preset.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ War's Retreat is used for easy access to the Barrows Brothers </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="dharokhead">https://files.catbox.moe/to1cz2.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513222840162582541.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• War's Retreat Teleport </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="warsretreatteleport">https://files.catbox.moe/ufjnaw.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032540079589163049.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> is unlocked via getting 10 boss kills (any boss).</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Using High Contrast Mode lets you see which door is clickable when in the tunnels.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Right-click the World Map to toggle it on.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>

<span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:540px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://files.catbox.moe/k751xn.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;font-size:0.85em;">[https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FK7fbsgueiX8Z1w9smbiN.png?alt=media Image source]</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The mid-level preset and example video can be used as a reference if you're interested in killing Akrisae and Linza.</nowiki></p>

<div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ The following allow you to increase the efficiency of your runs:
    • Although useful, they are </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> mandatory.
</nowiki></div>
<div><div><div><u><nowiki>Items</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Salve_amulet_(e) <nowiki>Salve amulet (e)</nowiki>] <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="salveamulet">[[File:Salve amulet (e).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>salveamulet</nowiki>|<nowiki>salveamulet</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>
    • Increases damage and accuracy by 20% when fighting undead monsters.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ghost_hunter_equipment <nowiki>Ghost hunter equipment</nowiki>] <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ghosthunterhelm">[[File:Ghost hunter goggles (70).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893808767016.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ghosthunterhelm</nowiki>|<nowiki>ghosthunterhelm</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>
    • Increases damage done against ghosts related creatures by 10% when three or more pieces are worn.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Powerburst_of_acceleration#(4) <nowiki>Powerburst of acceleration</nowiki>] <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="powerburstofacceleration">[[File:Powerburst of acceleration (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>powerburstofacceleration</nowiki>|<nowiki>powerburstofacceleration</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>
    • Surge </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and Dive </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dive">[[File:Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dive</nowiki>|<nowiki>dive</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> will increase the speed of your runs.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Other</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Luck <nowiki>Luck enhancers</nowiki>] <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="luckpotion">[[File:Enhanced luck potion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717295935500.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>luckpotion</nowiki>|<nowiki>luckpotion</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>
    • Increases chances at barrows equipment </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dharokbody">[[File:Dharok's platebody.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507658267164672.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dharokbody</nowiki>|<nowiki>dharokbody</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and amulet of the forsaken </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="amuletoftheforesaken">[[File:Amulet of the forsaken.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893934334012.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>amuletoftheforesaken</nowiki>|<nowiki>amuletoftheforesaken</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>
    • You only need tier 2 luck.
</nowiki></div></div></div>

<div>
<div>
<div>

<div><u><nowiki>The Brothers</nowiki></u>
</div>
<div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ As this is an older encounter, there aren't many mechanics to be wary of.
    • Each brother has a mechanic, which can mostly be ignored.
        ⬩ Dharok increases his damage dealt, the lower his life points get.
    • Being underground will periodically drain your prayer points.
    • The catacombs are a maze, with a simple puzzle at the end.
</nowiki></div>
<div><div><div><u><nowiki>The Catacombs</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ Searching one of the sarcophagi will place you in a random corner of the catacombs.
    • This sarcophagus is random, and normally reserved for last.
⬥ The catacombs are composed of a series of tunnels, in the shape of a 3x3 grid, with a treasure room in the center.
    • The path to the center is randomly generated.
    • Using High Contrast Mode makes finding the correct path easier.
⬥ The door leading to the center of the catacombs will have one of four, </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Barrows_Brothers/Strategies#The_tunnels <nowiki>simple puzzles</nowiki>]<nowiki>, which always have the same solution.
</nowiki></div></div></div>
</div>

</div>


</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>

<span id="the-fight" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>The Fight</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="order-the-brothers-should-be-killed" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Order the Brothers Should be Killed</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>Dharok → Ahrim → Karil → Guthan → Torag → Verac</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ You can use protection prayers to mitigate damage.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Protect from Melee </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="protectfrommelee">[[File:Protect from Melee.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551452788269127.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>protectfrommelee</nowiki>|<nowiki>protectfrommelee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> on Dharok, Guthan, Torag, and Verac.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Protect from Magic </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="protectfrommagic">[[File:Protect from Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551456835768351.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>protectfrommagic</nowiki>|<nowiki>protectfrommagic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> on Ahrim.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Protect from Ranged </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="protectfrommissiles">[[File:Protect from Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551455078367313.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>protectfrommissiles</nowiki>|<nowiki>protectfrommissiles</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> on Karil.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Try to make good use of Surge </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and Dive </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dive">[[File:Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dive</nowiki>|<nowiki>dive</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
